dedupe_keys.name: sapos hochpraziser echtzeit positionierungs service heps

description: SAPOS® - Hochpräziser Echtzeit Positionierungs-Service (HEPS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The high-precision real-time positioning service provides the user with a correction signal to improve their GNSS observations (GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO and BEIDOU). The data is submitted in RTCM 3.x format via Internet (Ntrip) every second. Accuracy: Location 1 – 2 centimetres and height 2 – 3 centimetres. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SAPOS® - High-precision real-time positioning service (HEPS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HEPS, AdVMIS, SAPOS, Schleswig-Holstein. The listing shows 2023-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
